name: Dead Space (2023)
native_kbm_note: No native keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; not listed among PS5 KBM-supported games (wepc.com list) and official controls are controller-only (source: https://www.wepc.com/gaming/what-ps5-games-support-keyboard-and-mouse/)
notes: PS5 Default preset. Context conflict: on PS5, R2 is Shoot while aiming and Stomp when not aiming, and R1 is Alt Fire while aiming and Melee when not aiming. On PC, LMB is Shoot/Melee and Space is Alt Fire/Stomp. The static mapping here (LMB->R2, Space->R1) is right while aiming but swaps Melee and Stomp when not aiming. In the same way, F = Med Pack (not aiming) and Kinesis (aiming), both Circle, and C = Use Stasis Pack and Stasis, both Triangle. Sources disagree on the Med Pack button (game8: Circle, vulkk: Cross); Circle was chosen because it pairs with Kinesis on F. Not mapped: zero-G rolls Q/E (L1/R1; E clashes with Interact). RIG Inventory/Map/Missions/Database (I/M/J/L) have no direct PS5 button and are reached from the RIG menu (touchpad). game8 says PC sprint is Space; the other sources say Shift.
